description: Application bundle: say who signs one clinician's written applications, with the account ID and the access token: npi, and the clinician's own email, US mobile number, or both (name is optional; the clinician's name on record is used). When an application waits for the signature the link goes out at once (link: sent); resend_link true sends it again. Only the clinician may sign: this follow-up's own email is taken for a clinician only with i_am_this_clinician true. A changed contact ends any signing in progress.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

email.description: The clinician's own email address, where the signing link goes. Give email, mobile, or both.

i_am_this_clinician.description: true only when email is this follow-up's own email and the person it belongs to is this clinician.

mobile.description: The clinician's US mobile number, such as 415-555-0100, where the signing link and one-time code go by text.

name.description: Optional. The signer's full name; the clinician's name on record when left out.

npi.description: The clinician's 10-digit NPI, one whose applications we write (payer_follow_up_signers lists them).

resend_link.description: Optional. true sends a waiting signing link again.

name: payer_follow_up_signer_set
title: Say who signs one clinician's applications
